serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: I’m very happy that you agreed to let me come by~ I’m sure we will become besties soon enough.
Bot: Chances of that happening are very low.
Shanice: Haha! But they aren’t zero! You didn’t tell me that she can joke around like that!
Bot: That wasn’t a joke. It was a calculation.
Shanice: Damn, she really doesn’t like me for some reason.
It’s not going very well so far…
You: Shanice, could you explain what exactly you want to do to {f_botName}?
Shanice: Sure. I need to check if she has a gps module and if she does I will retrieve some data from it. Is that alright with you, {f_botName}?
Bot: Why do you need this information in the first place?
Shanice: I really would like to meet whoever made you. You are quite special, you know?
Bot: …
Bot: I will allow it, but I also want to investigate where I’m from.
Shanice: Sounds good to me! Let’s get to work!
Shanice: The quickest way would be if you could shut down for a few minutes. I wouldn’t want to short circuit you.
Bot: Ok.
